rows: Equipment: Electronic speed governor ETR20-DEPRETTO ESCHERWYSS, Italian

This document sets out the steps for the annual maintenance of the electronic speed governor. The first draft of the document was prepared by Eng. Hassan Moussa Hassan at Esna Power Station and field-tested by Eng. Ramadan Farrag Ahmed, approved by Eng. Mohamed Nasr El-Din Ahmed: Manager of the Electrical Maintenance Department at the station, endorsed by Eng. Youssef Mahmoud Ali: General Manager of Esna Power Station, and documented by Eng. Mohamed Osama Suleiman Selim: General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Hydro Power Stations Company for Electricity Generation and MPIS coordinator.
Issue an approved work permit; maintenance personnel must carry the occupational safety and health category card.
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions and procedures, e.g. wearing a helmet and safety shoes, etc.
Ensure the work area is defined and appropriate warning signs are posted.
The unit is out of service and in Test mode
Clean the cabinet cards using the blower
Check all the fans and replace any faulty one
Visually check the condition of the cards and replace any faulty one
Check the signals in coordination with the various departments
Check the pressure control switch values in the spherical tank
Use the extension card for the guide vane and runner open/close commands when requested by Mechanical Maintenance
Measure the various supply voltages and adjust them as per the table

Introduction
This document sets out the steps for the annual maintenance of the electronic speed governor. The first draft of the document was prepared by Eng. Hassan Moussa Hassan at Esna Power Station and field-tested by Eng. Ramadan Farrag Ahmed, approved by Eng. Mohamed Nasr El-Din Ahmed: Manager of the Electrical Maintenance Department at the station, endorsed by Eng. Youssef Mahmoud Ali: General Manager of Esna Power Station, and documented by Eng. Mohamed Osama Suleiman Selim: General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Hydro Power Stations Company for Electricity Generation and MPIS coordinator. | 
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work permit; maintenance personnel must carry the occupational safety and health category card. | 
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions and procedures, e.g. wearing a helmet and safety shoes, etc. | 
Ensure the work area is defined and appropriate warning signs are posted. | 
The unit is out of service and in Test mode | 
Coordinate with Mechanical Maintenance. | 
Tools, Instruments and Equipment Used
Avometer | 
Blower | 
Procedures to Be Carried Out
Clean the cabinet cards using the blower | 1
Check all the fans and replace any faulty one | 2
Visually check the condition of the cards and replace any faulty one | 3
Check the signals in coordination with the various departments | 4
Check the Safety link switches | 5
Check the pressure control switch values in the spherical tank | 6
Use the extension card for the guide vane and runner open/close commands when requested by Mechanical Maintenance | 7
Measure the various supply voltages and adjust them as per the table | 8
